fact: An APAI-CRVS/UNECA presentation (July 2026) describes Ethiopia's national eCRVS as a phased rollout: pilot in Addis Ababa, scale-up to Amharic-speaking regions, then national expansion to non-Amharic regions.
The same presentation lists death registration and certificate, with health-facility death notification, among the services of the national eCRVS system, which it says improved CRVS operations.

The Government Communication Service quotes the Ethiopian AI Institute saying that in Addis Ababa, as a pilot, family registration and vital events registration are being implemented through a digital system connected from central level to woreda level.
system: Addis Ababa civil registration digital pilot

fact: ENA reports Addis Ababa's mayor launched the Integrated Civil Registration and Residency Service Technology, integrating vital events registration with residency identification, with full implementation in 50 woredas from 8 December 2025.
system: Integrated Civil Registration and Residency Service Technology

fact: The Immigration and Citizenship Services presentation says a tablet-based ME-CRVS system was piloted in 1,300 kebeles and health facilities, alongside home-grown digital systems in Oromia and Amhara and open-source ones federally and in Addis Ababa, and that the government decided to standardize a digital civil registration system nationwide.
The Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Resident Services Agency director general says its project to digitize all services is in a pilot phase, with 21 of 116 woredas already digitized.
system: Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Resident Services Agency digitization

fact: Addis Ababa Mayor Adanech Abiebie said on 2025-12-05 that the city has launched an integrated digital civil registration and residency system, now operational and replacing previously paper-based processes (city only, no national rollout stated).
system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics with ID System

fact: The Addis Ababa City Administration launched a digital civil registration system replacing 14 years of manual process, starting operations in 50 woredas of the city.
system: AI-enriched integrated digital civil registration and resident services system

fact: The Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Residency Services Agency says its civil registration is being integrated with the digital ID to digitise life events from birth to death.
